title: Why We Watch at All
sentences: I have spent an unreasonable share of my life watching other people run.
Rationally, the result of any single match changes nothing whatsoever.
That argument has never once reduced my interest by a measurable amount.
Part of the appeal is that the outcome is genuinely unknown.
Very little else in adult life offers uncertainty in such a contained form.
There is also the fact of belonging to a crowd that wants the same thing.
I am suspicious of that feeling and enjoy it enormously at the same time.
The players themselves have almost nothing to do with the town any more.
We support a name, a colour and a long series of borrowed memories.
Knowing this has not persuaded me to stop.
